newsitem.title: USA: Lund Intl sees Q3 sales below expectation.
newsitem.headline: Lund Intl sees Q3 sales below expectation.

text.p: Lund International Holdings Inc said on Friday sales for its March 31 third-quarter will be below expectations. Citing the lack of availability of newly developed products, a spokeswoman said the trend is affecting the company's bottom line as well.
The consensus among analysts was for sales of $12.9 million on earnings per share of $0.15. A year ago, Lund earned $0.28 per share on sales of $11.5 million in the quarter.

"Sales volume for the third quarter did not reflect the historical increases usually achieved over the first and second quarter," said president William McMahon in a statement. "We do not expect this trend to reverse during the fourth quarter, since the impact of new product sales will not be evident until early for fiscal 1998."

McMahon said Lund was refining its new visor lines and, as a result, these product lines did not ship during the third quarter as originally expected. He said, "We anticipate that all refinements and road tests will be complete and product will begin shipping during the first quarter of fiscal 1998."
Lund, which manufactures and markets a broad line of appearance accessories for new and used light trucks, said it expects to release third-quarter results on May 7.

The company also said initial shipmentsof two of its tonneau cover lines, the HatchBack and the Elite, which were expected to begin during the third quarter of fiscal 1997, will begin during the fourth quarter of this fiscal year.
